definition: Captive MNC-owned legal subsidiaries operating in India with established product, ER&D, or shared services mandates. Excludes pure-play third party IT/BPO service providers and units under 50 employees.
whyItDiffers: Conservative baseline counting only distinct parent corporations with fully incorporated wholly-owned Indian entities.

definition: Individual physical campuses or multi-city delivery locations. A single corporation (e.g. JPMorgan or Amazon) with offices across Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and Mumbai is tallied as 3 distinct centers.
whyItDiffers: Measures physical real estate footprint and city dispersion rather than parent entity consolidation.

definition: Updated corporate registry tracking post-2024 surge, expanding criteria to include venture-backed scaleups ($100M+ ARR) establishing strategic engineering centers in India.
whyItDiffers: Reflects 24 months of post-FY24 net new entrants and broadening of the mid-market definition.

definition: Includes both incorporated entities and active Employer-of-Record (EOR) / BOT 'pre-incorporation' units that function as dedicated GCCs under partner umbrellas.
whyItDiffers: Broader boundary capturing companies in incubation or early growth phase before formal ROC incorporation.

definition: Captive MNC operations with minimum headcount thresholds (>100 staff) based on client and regulatory tax reporting audits.
whyItDiffers: Blends NASSCOM baseline with proprietary transfer-pricing tax client databases.

definition: Casual rounded figure repeatedly cited in headlines, conflating corporate entities with active leases or projected 2025 thresholds.
whyItDiffers: Journalistic shorthand that lacks explicit definitional boundaries or reconciliation footnotes.
